phases.objective: Restore exact-head pull-request execution of the canonical Syntax Check and Unit & Integration Tests while the existing CI workflow registration incident remains under investigation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targets main or Production and triggers .github/workflows/ci-pull-request-recovery.yml.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow checks out the exact pull-request head SHA, completes Syntax Check before Unit & Integration Tests, and exposes no write, deployment, credential, provider, migration, database, or external-send authority.
steps: Trigger only for opened, reopened, synchronize, or ready_for_review pull-request events targeting main or Production, with optional manual diagnostic dispatch.
Reject cross-repository pull-request execution at the job boundary.
Checkout the exact pull-request head SHA twice and verify git rev-parse HEAD before executing tests.
Run the same canonical syntax, generated-output, authentication, architecture, Spec Kit, and JavaScript checks used by CI.
Run npm installation, context-kernel ratchet, complete unit and integration tests, runtime startup evidence, governance contracts, and stale-evidence rejection.
Publish only bounded unit/integration progress artifacts and preserve read-only repository permissions.
assertions: The workflow uses pull_request rather than pull_request_target.
Repository permissions are contents: read only.
Both jobs bind checkout and deployment evidence to github.event.pull_request.head.sha or the manual-dispatch SHA.
Unit & Integration Tests require Syntax Check success.

The recovery workflow contains no actions write, contents write, deployments write, id-token write, secret reference, workflow dispatch command, provider call, deployment, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send.
The canonical .github/workflows/ci.yml remains unchanged and still declares its existing pull-request trigger.

phases.objective: Observe exact-head recovery workflow results across multiple same-repository pull-request lifecycle events while the canonical CI registration cause is diagnosed.
Retain fail-closed exact-SHA checkout, cross-repository rejection, non-cancelling evidence, and bounded diagnostics during runner or registration incidents.
Prove one Draft and one Ready pull-request cycle before considering the recovery workflow authoritative for temporary CI evidence.
Resolve or replace the canonical CI registration path without weakening protected-branch requirements or granting deployment authority.
